chatgpt._note: stop_streaming_candidates are tried in order; first match wins. ChatGPT has changed the stop-button selector multiple times. If all stop selectors fail, the script falls back to waiting for the send button to re-enable. Run ask-chatgpt.py with --screenshot-dir to debug. Internal chatgpt.com links are excluded from citations.

deepseek._note: send_button and assistant_message use CSS module hashes (from main.*.js bundle). These may change on deployments. Fallback: assistant_message_stable uses a CSS variable selector that is more stable. Run ask-deepseek.py with --screenshot-dir to debug. CSS class discovery: grep sendButton/assistantMessage in main.*.js bundle.
deepseek._discovery_method: Extracted from https://fe-static.deepseek.com/chat/static/main.cd620c850b.js bundle analysis. Module exports: sendButton='_7436101', disabled='bcc55ca1', assistantMessage='_4f9bf79', textarea='_27c9245'.

gemini._note: No login required — Gemini permits anonymous usage. Input is a Quill editor; use page.keyboard.type() instead of fill(). Send button starts as aria-disabled='true' (hidden) until text is typed. Response text is in model-response.textContent (not innerText — innerText is layout-truncated). Citations appear as Google search redirect hrefs: https://www.google.com/search?q=<encoded_actual_url> — extract the 'q' query parameter.
gemini._generation_lifecycle: 1. pending-response element appears in DOM = generation started. 2. pending-response detaches from DOM = generation complete.
gemini._extraction_method: document.querySelector('model-response').textContent — strip leading ' Gemini said ' prefix. No shadow DOM pierce needed: model-response is directly accessible in the regular DOM.
gemini._auth: none — fully stateless, each invocation starts a fresh anonymous conversation at https://gemini.google.com/app

qwen._note: Login requires email + password; no CAPTCHA. Password is SHA-256 hashed by browser JS before submission — no client-side hashing needed in Playwright. Token is stored in localStorage['token'] and used as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. For token injection, set localStorage.setItem('token', value) and reload. For login success check: URL leaves /auth page within 15s. stop-button is conditionally rendered (not just hidden): appears during generation, detaches when done.
qwen._auth_modes: 1) Token injection: set localStorage['token'] from DevTools → Application → Local Storage → chat.qwen.ai → 'token' key. 2) Email+password env vars: QWEN_WEB_EMAIL + QWEN_WEB_PASSWORD (no CAPTCHA, auto-login).
qwen._login_api: POST https://chat.qwen.ai/api/v2/auths/signin with body {email, password: sha256(password)}. Token returned as response.token or response.user.token → stored to localStorage['token'].
qwen._generation_lifecycle: 1. button.stop-button appears in DOM = generation started. 2. button.stop-button detaches from DOM = generation complete. Button is conditionally rendered by React (not CSS hidden), so wait_for_selector state='detached' works correctly.
qwen._discovery_method: Analyzed https://assets.alicdn.com/g/qwenweb/qwen-chat-fe/0.2.35/js/main.js bundle. send_button, stop_button use stable CSS class names (not CSS module hashes). Auth flow: SHA-256 hashing done by browser React code.
